This planet was the '''homeworld''' of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] species. The planet was attacked by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] at one point, with most of its native population killed in the fighting.<ref name="TORns" />
